rows.ja: クラウド基盤・販売先
競合(相手の年次報告に記載)

relations.text: Falconプラットフォームを主にAWS上で運用し、自社データセンターで補完(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Hosts its Falcon platform primarily on AWS, supplemented by its own data centers (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We currently host our Falcon platform and serve our customers using a mix of third-party data centers, primarily Amazon Web Services, Inc., or AWS, and our data centers
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com.

relations.text: AWSがAWS Marketplaceで統合SIEMを提供する最初のセキュリティ提携先としてCrowdStrikeを選定(2025年12月、8-K)
relations.text_en: AWS selected CrowdStrike as the first cybersecurity partner to deliver an integrated SIEM through SaaS Quick Launch in AWS Marketplace (December 2025, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: AWS selected CrowdStrike as the first cybersecurity partner to deliver an integrated SIEM through an enhanced version of SaaS Quick Launch in AWS Marketplace.
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com.

relations.text: AWSと協力してAI・クラウド・Next-Gen SIEMの新機能を発表し、Project QuiltWorksをAWSと拡大(2026年8月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Introduced AI, cloud and Next-Gen SIEM innovations in collaboration with AWS and extended Project QuiltWorks with AWS (August 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Introduced new AI, cloud, and Next-Gen SIEM innovations in collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com.

relations.text: Microsoftとの戦略的提携を拡大し、FalconをMicrosoft Marketplaceで既存のAzure利用コミットメントを使って購入可能にした(2026年3月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Expanded its strategic alliance with Microsoft so the Falcon platform can be bought on Microsoft Marketplace using Azure Consumption Commitment (March 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Announced an expansion of a strategic alliance with Microsoft that allows organizations to purchase the Falcon platform on Microsoft Marketplace using their existing Microsoft Azure Consumption Commitment.

relations.text: Falcon AIDRを、Microsoft Azureを含むAIゲートウェイ提携先に拡大(2026年8月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Extended Falcon AIDR to AI gateway partners including Microsoft Azure (August 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Extended CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (AIDR) across leading AI gateway partners, including Databricks, Google Cloud, JetStream Security, Kong, LiteLLM, Maxim AI, Microsoft Azure, and TrueFoundry.
source.note: Microsoft Azureは複数のゲートウェイ提携先の1つとして挙げられています。
source.note_en: Microsoft Azure is listed among several gateway partners.

relations.text: Microsoft Defender環境への対応を拡大(Falcon OverWatch for Defender、Next-Gen SIEM連携)(2026年6月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Expanded support for Microsoft Defender environments (Falcon OverWatch for Defender, Next-Gen SIEM integration) (June 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Expanded support for Microsoft Defender environments by launching Falcon OverWatch for Defender for managed threat hunting and Falcon Next-Gen SIEM integration

relations.text: Google CloudにCloud Detection and Responseを拡大し、2026年のGoogle Cloudセキュリティ・パートナー・オブ・ザ・イヤー(インフラ保護部門)に選出、Google Agent Cloud Ecosystemのローンチ・パートナーにも選定(2026年6月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Expanded Cloud Detection and Response to Google Cloud, named 2026 Google Cloud Security Partner of the Year (Infrastructure Protection) and a launch partner for the Google Agent Cloud Ecosystem (June 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Named the 2026 Google Cloud Security Partner of the Year for Infrastructure Protection for the second consecutive year and selected as a launch partner for the Google Agent Cloud Ecosystem
source.note: Google CloudはAlphabetの事業部門です。
source.note_en: Google Cloud is a unit of Alphabet.

relations.text: AWS Marketplaceに加え、Google MarketplaceとMicrosoft MarketplaceでもFalconを販売(2026年度、10-K)
relations.text_en: Sells the Falcon platform via Google Marketplace and Microsoft Marketplace in addition to AWS Marketplace (FY2026 10-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: In addition to AWS, we bring CrowdStrike to market through Google Marketplace, and starting fiscal year 2027, the Microsoft Marketplace.
source.note: Google CloudはAlphabetの事業部門です。
source.note_en: Google Cloud is a unit of Alphabet.

relations.text: CoreWeaveと、エージェント時代の安全なAIクラウド基盤に向けたグローバルな提携を発表(2025年12月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Unveiled a global partnership with CoreWeave for a secure AI cloud foundation (December 2025, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Unveiled a global partnership with CoreWeave to power the secure AI cloud foundation for the agentic era

relations.text: NVIDIAと協業し、Nemotron・NeMo・NIMを使うCharlotte AI AgentWorksを展開(2025年12月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Collaborated with NVIDIA on Charlotte AI AgentWorks using Nemotron, NeMo and NIM (December 2025, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Collaborated with NVIDIA to bring always-on, continuously learning AI agents for cybersecurity to the edge through Charlotte AI AgentWorks, NVIDIA Nemotron open models

relations.text: AWS、NVIDIA、OpenAIとともにCharlotte AI AgentWorks Ecosystemを立ち上げ(2026年6月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Charlotte AI AgentWorks Ecosystem was created with AWS, NVIDIA and OpenAI (June 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Launched the Charlotte AI AgentWorks Ecosystem, a no-code development platform created with AWS, NVIDIA, and OpenAI
source.note: 複数社との共同の取り組みです。

relations.text: Intelとの戦略的協業を拡大し、FalconをAI PC向けに最適化(2026年6月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Expanded a strategic collaboration with Intel to optimize Falcon for AI PCs (June 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Expanded a strategic collaboration with Intel to optimize the Falcon platform for AI PCs

relations.text: AWS、Intel、Meta、NVIDIA、Salesforceとともに、企業のAIを守る新機能を発表(2025年12月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Announced innovations with AWS, Intel, Meta, NVIDIA and Salesforce to secure enterprise AI (December 2025, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Announced innovations with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Intel, Meta, NVIDIA, and Salesforce to secure the future of enterprise AI.
source.note: 複数社の共同発表の中の1社です。

relations.text: AWS、Intel、Meta、NVIDIAとともに、Salesforceと企業のAIを守る新機能を発表(2025年12月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Announced innovations with Salesforce (among others) to secure enterprise AI (December 2025, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Announced innovations with Amazon Web Services (AWS), Intel, Meta, NVIDIA, and Salesforce to secure the future of enterprise AI.
source.note: 複数社の共同発表の中の1社です。

relations.text: IBMとの戦略的協業を拡大し、Charlotte AIをIBMのATOMと統合してエージェント型SOCを推進(2026年6月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Expanded a strategic collaboration with IBM to integrate Charlotte AI with IBM’s ATOM for agentic SOC (June 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Announced an expanded strategic collaboration with IBM to accelerate agentic SOC transformation by integrating Charlotte AI with IBM

relations.text: OpenAIとAnthropicが参加するサイバーセキュリティ連合Project QuiltWorksを立ち上げ、OpenAIのTrusted Access for Cyberのローンチ・パートナーにもなった(2026年6月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Launched the Project QuiltWorks cybersecurity coalition featuring OpenAI and Anthropic, and is a launch partner in OpenAI’s Trusted Access for Cyber (June 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Announced the launch and expansion of Project QuiltWorks, an industry-first cybersecurity coalition featuring OpenAI and Anthropic to remediate frontier AI risk via the Falcon platform.

relations.text: AnthropicのProject Glasswingと、Anthropicが参加するQuiltWorks連合の両方でローンチ・パートナー(2026年6月、8-K)
relations.text_en: A launch partner in Anthropic’s Project Glasswing and in the QuiltWorks coalition featuring Anthropic (June 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: The only cybersecurity company selected as a launch partner in both Anthropic

relations.text: サウジアラビアでAramcoと覚書(MoU)を締結(2026年3月、8-K)
relations.text_en: Signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) in Saudi Arabia with Aramco (March 2026, 8-K)

source.label: CrowdStrike 8-K Ex.99.1
source.quote: Signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) in Saudi Arabia with Aramco.
source.note: 覚書(MoU)のみで、正式な商取引の契約は書かれていません。サウジ証券取引所(Tadawul)上場です。
source.note_en: An MoU only; no definitive commercial agreement is stated. Aramco is listed on Tadawul.

relations.text: Dell MDRをCrowdStrike Falcon XDRプラットフォーム上で提供する提携を拡大(2024年3月5日、Dell発表)
relations.text_en: Dell and CrowdStrike expanded their partnership to deliver Dell MDR on the CrowdStrike Falcon XDR platform (March 5, 2024, Dell release)

source.label: Dell Technologies の発表
source.quote: announced an expanded strategic partnership to deliver Dell’s Managed Detection and Response (MDR) services with the industry-leading AI-native CrowdStrike Falcon
source.note: 2024年の発表で、現在の状況は再確認していません。
source.note_en: A 2024 release; the current status has not been re-confirmed.
